summary.en-US: Show pinned folders and recent bookmarks on new tab page.

version.approval_notes: Build from the attached source: `npm ci && npm run build:firefox` (Node 25, npm 11). Output is dist/ and dist/new-tab-recent-bookmarks-<version>.xpi. The UI is Preact + TypeScript bundled with Vite, hence the minified output. The `tabs` permission is used only to cache favicons of visited bookmarks (see faviconcacher.ts).
